prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A three-day plan for Lisbon, from hilltop viewpoints and historic trams to custard tarts and grilled fish. Learn what to see, what to eat and how to pace each day.

beats.narration: Imagine a yellow tram rattling up a steep cobbled street, the smell of fresh pastry drifting from a corner bakery. That is Lisbon, and three days is enough to fall for it.
Lisbon is built on hills beside a wide river. Expect steep climbs, tiled facades and sweeping views. So pack comfortable shoes, and plan one neighborhood per half day.
Start with day one in the old center. Wander Alfama, the oldest district, with its narrow lanes and little squares. Climb to the castle for a view over red rooftops and the river.
In the evening, find a small restaurant and listen for fado, the soulful Portuguese music. Order grilled sardines or fresh fish, simple and full of flavor.

clip_queries: people dining at outdoor restaurant evening

beats.narration: Day two heads west to Belem. See the Jeronimos Monastery and the Belem Tower, both reminders of the age of exploration. Then take a break for the famous custard tarts.

image_queries: Portuguese custard tarts pasteis de nata

beats.narration: After lunch, ride back toward the center and walk along the river. Watch boats drift by, and stop at a kiosk for coffee as the afternoon light turns golden.
On day three, explore the lively streets of Baixa and Chiado. Browse the shops, ride the old elevator, and stop in a market hall to taste cheese, cured ham and fresh fruit.
Finish at a hilltop viewpoint at sunset. Bring a drink, sit on the stone wall, and watch the city turn pink and gold. It is the best free show in town.
A few tips help. Walk early to beat the crowds, use trams and metro for the hills, and always leave time to simply wander and eat.

props.heading: Quick tips
items: Use trams and metro on hills

beats.narration: So, three days: old streets, river light and custard tarts. Lisbon rewards slow, curious travelers. Pick your neighborhoods, follow your appetite, and let the hills lead the way.

props.text: Lisbon rewards the slow, curious traveler.
